projects.name: Directional Stationarity
projects.title: Achieving Directional-Stationarity from a Single Random Direction Step
projects.implemented: REP exploration, DCA baselines, ReLU proximal models and stationarity diagnostics.
projects.validation: 400 instances · 1,900 runs · all publicly reported experiment scales executed.
projects.result: Trimmed Lasso: 99 wins / 1 tie / 0 losses, matching the reported count; overall numerical results still differ.
projects.limitations: Some counts match; overall numerical results differ. Several original settings remain unspecified.
projects.image_caption: Trimmed Lasso local trajectories; representative instance, not the original paper instance.

projects.name: Quadratic Bézier Splatting
projects.title: Quadratic Bezier Splatting with Structural Initialization for Efficient Painting Rendering
projects.implemented: Analytic Bézier rendering, stroke auditing, adaptive optimization and initializer architecture.
projects.validation: Three-image, three-seed paired pilot · 18 runs · CPU/MPS numerical checks.
projects.result: Stroke auditing: +0.2309 dB mean paired PSNR across 9 pairs; 8 improve and 1 declines.
projects.limitations: No completed learned-initializer training, full benchmark or paper-equivalent CUDA speedup.
projects.image_caption: Three-image local comparison at 128×128 with 128 strokes; no trained initializer.

projects.name: KoalaGS
projects.title: KoalaGS: Complexity-Aware Continuous Level of Detail for Gaussian Splatting
projects.implemented: Complexity-aware relocation, prefix training, variance regularization and SH3 rendering.
projects.validation: Two local experiment rounds · 12 expanded training runs · CPU/MPS checks.
projects.result: SH3 vs SH0: +1.102 PSNR AUC. KoalaGS vs prefix: +0.040 on average, two seeds win and one loses.
projects.limitations: Small-scale Lego evaluation; relative prefix-baseline advantage is not consistent across seeds.
projects.image_caption: All three seeds at common 48×48 evaluation; two training rounds use different capacities.

projects.name: PhySPRING
projects.title: PhySPRING: Structure-Preserving Reduction of Physics-Informed Twins via GNN
projects.implemented: Hierarchical GNN reduction, mechanical projection, frozen topology and differentiable rollouts.
projects.validation: Three local rounds · 18 latest real-subset runs · force/gradient and replay audits.
projects.result: Local learned L3: 27.08 ± 0.79 mm future observation error; independent tracks still favor geometry.
projects.limitations: One cloth subset; independent tracks still favor geometry. Full paper benchmarks remain incomplete.
projects.image_caption: Real cloth subset and force diagnostics; panels use different metrics and cannot be compared directly.

projects.name: MatrixSplat
projects.title: MatrixSplat: Matrix-Parallel and Feature-Scalable 3D Gaussian Splatting Rendering on GPUs
projects.implemented: Weighted matrix rendering, tiled accumulation, channel slicing and differentiable projection.
projects.validation: Five local cycles · five training seeds · 144 final GPU benchmark configurations.
projects.result: Held-out RGB PSNR: 10.66 → 33.21 dB across 5 synthetic training seeds. 144 GPU timing configurations.
projects.limitations: No NVIDIA kernel, official datasets or paper-equivalent speed comparisons.
projects.image_caption: Held-out synthetic rendering; fixed geometry, local appearance/blending optimization.

projects.name: SimuScene
projects.title: SimuScene: Simulation-Ready Compositional 3D Scene Reconstruction from a Single Image
projects.implemented: Sequential placement, penetration correction, gravity diagnostics and attachment constraints.
projects.validation: Five local cycles · 64 seeds · eight scene families · 2,048 final synthetic runs.
projects.result: Synthetic stack IoU: 0.89443 → 0.99660. Pose-only errors worsen; severe cases remain unresolved.
projects.limitations: Geometry/physics components only; no complete image-to-scene pipeline or original benchmarks.
projects.image_caption: Procedural scenes before and after geometry/physics correction; not image-to-scene reconstruction.

projects.name: Articulation in Prime
projects.title: Articulation in Prime: Primitive-Based Articulated Object Understanding from a Single Casual Video
projects.progress: Core audit + one original Arti4D cue; code not published
projects.implemented: Corrected angular SQ mesh, reversible observation-only normalization, all original losses, CPU rasterization plus continuous-SQ oracle, and explicit coverage-aware pruning; SAM2/GMSF RGB-D preprocessing.
projects.validation: 14 tests · 25 paired procedural audit runs · six original Arti4D pilot fits · 25 audit and six real objectives replayed; initial 30 runs retained.
projects.result: Scale sensitivity reduces one selected procedural pivot/state error to 8.47 cm / 6.59°, but only 1/5 types is correct. Original Arti4D weights: 0/3 correct types; no-motion: 1/3, selected axis 28.79° and pivot 39.67 cm.
projects.limitations: Joint bias and collapse remain. One 25×512 RGB-D cue pilot, not the author 11-object benchmark or full 10k configuration. Unknown normalization/pruning; no GT states/labels. Video2Articulation-S Pending; code unpublished.
projects.image_caption: Top: procedural hinge, 8×256 points, five seeds per setting, 2000 steps; rings mark minimum loss; extra refit is separate. Bottom left: one original Arti4D cue, 25×512 core input, three seeds per setting; bottom right: extent4 seed2 pruning losses. No original table matched.

projects.name: Rigel3D
projects.title: Rigel3D: Rig-aware Latents for Animation-Ready 3D Asset Generation
projects.progress: Original subset decoder training + generation-data preflight; code not published
projects.implemented: AR skeleton decoder with BOS/EOS, parent constraints, positional encodings and masks; trained skinning; bounded original-data adapter; one real mesh/frozen-DINO multiview preflight.
projects.validation: 16 tests · original 96/16/32 asset split · nine MPS training runs · all nine checkpoints replayed on CPU · no source-family overlap.
projects.result: Skin element L1×100: 3.484±0.084 vs geometry-rig 3.490±0.070 and distance control 3.501. Balanced EOS reduces cap hits from 96/96 to 2/96, but J2J×100 worsens from 13.341 to 15.015; train-rig retrieval is better (10.015).
projects.limitations: Small GT-rig-conditioned reconstruction proxies; no full Sparse VAE, FlexiCubes, trained image generators or original paper table matched. Unweighted EOS fails; geometry remains inaccurate. Raw data and implementation remain local.
projects.image_caption: Original Anymate subset reconstruction proxies: 96 train/16 validation/32 test; three seeds per condition, 2000 steps, width64/layers2. GT rig geometry is supplied; rig-context features also use GT skinning. Dots: seeds; error bars: sample SD. Not image-conditioned generation or paper-table reproduction.
